name: build_bike_lane_inboard
notes: AddBikeLane(grand_central_ave_south, left): 5 ft lane, 1.6 ft buffer, parking-protected behind 20 ft of marked parking. Pinned to the left kerb, spending 27.55 ft of this leg's 69.90 ft between kerbs at its narrowest, leaving 42.35 ft to the right kerb for the travel lanes and whatever that kerb is given, with the travel way shifted 3.71 ft toward it.

AddBikeLaneBollards(grand_central_ave_south, left): flex-post delineators at 10 ft in the 2 ft buffer between the travel lane and the bike lane - the traffic side, which is the side that needs protecting.

AddBikeLane(grand_central_ave_north, right): 5 ft lane, 1.6 ft buffer, parking-protected behind 20 ft of marked parking. Pinned to the right kerb, spending 27.55 ft of this leg's 69.57 ft between kerbs at its narrowest, leaving 42.02 ft to the left kerb for the travel lanes and whatever that kerb is given, with the travel way shifted 3.70 ft toward it.

AddBikeLaneBollards(grand_central_ave_north, right): flex-post delineators at 10 ft in the 2 ft buffer between the travel lane and the bike lane - the traffic side, which is the side that needs protecting.
